message.text:
The compiled React frontend is served via `go:embed` of the `dist` directory, served through Echo's static middleware with SPA fallback. This wiring is located in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go`.

`server/server.go` wires the service into the server via `frontend.NewFrontendService(...).Serve(...)`.

q27.
go:embed of `dist` served as Echo static/SPA files; server/router/frontend/frontend.go

`//go:embed dist/*` and `FrontendService.Serve` in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go` expose the built assets via `middleware.StaticWithConfig` plus `spaFallbackMiddleware` (`index.html`). `server/server.go` registers that with `frontend.NewFrontendService(...).Serve(...)`.
